audit.whatIsWrong: The enum rows are now correct (Teemo 4 / Skill 3, matching a 46.25% win rate over 1453 games) but every piece of prose under them still describes Zaahen winning: whys[1] 'Level 2 favours you', whys[2] 'Level 3 stays yours', whys[5] 'your durability... beat his poke', whys[6] 'you win the isolated 1v1', plus mid, late and three of the four spikes.
audit.why: The mirror audit flipped the enum rows and explicitly recorded that it could not rewrite the surrounding prose inside the length band. That prose is now the stale half, and the page renders two opposite answers to who wins the lane. The packet's own levelChart (Zaahen 4/7) is the defective artefact here, not the current rows.
audit.corrected: Rewrite whys[1], whys[2], whys[5], whys[6], the spikes, early, mid and late to agree with the rows — Teemo owns 2, 3, first item and two-plus items.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns, and the level-6 spike treats Noxious Trap as if it had a normal cast rhythm.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank — it comes back faster than any Zaahen ability. Move Quick is 14s and breaks the moment you land a hit. Noxious Trap is effectively instant (0.25s) off stored charges, so it is a map problem rather than a cooldown you wait out. Zaahen's Q and E are 10s at rank 1, W 14s, R 110s.
audit.corrected: State Blinding Dart's flat 7s as the clock the whole lane runs on, and describe the shrooms as charges rather than a cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says twice that Blinding Dart 'only blinds one auto, not your ability damage'. Blind suppresses basic attacks for its full duration — and The Darkin Glaive is an on-attack ability that fires through a basic attack, so the blind cancels Zaahen's Q outright. That inverts the advice given. Toxic Shot's on-hit magic poison is also never mentioned, and Zaahen's E is called 'Golden Onslaught' rather than Aureate Rush.
audit.why: Riot's text: Blinding Dart 'Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.' Toxic Shot: 'Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target On-Hit.' The missing-interaction file flags onhit-itemization — his damage scales with attack speed and is magic, so armour reads the trade wrong and Mercury's Treads plus MR is the answer.
audit.corrected: State that the blind eats The Darkin Glaive, so trade with Aureate Rush and the 850 pull instead of attacks; and put MR on the item line because Toxic Shot is magic on-hit, not physical.

edits.before: Level 2 favours you — you gap-close and delete squishy Teemo when his Q is down.
edits.after: Level 2 is his — Blinding Dart turns off your Q entirely for its duration.

edits.before: Level 3 stays yours as your Q-E burst beats his poke once you reach him.
edits.after: Level 3 stays his as Toxic Shot poison outranges anything you reach.

edits.before: At first item your durability and P sustain beat his poke through the blind.
edits.after: At first item his on-hit poison and blind out-trade your melee sustain.

edits.before: With 2+ items you win the isolated 1v1 against a no-escape squishy poke champ.
edits.after: With 2+ items his shrooms and blind keep you off him in every side lane.

edits.before: Your leverage is any moment you actually reach him: with Darkin Glaive (Q) and Golden Onslaught (E) you gap-close and delete squishy Teemo, and his Blinding Dart (Q) only blinds one auto, not your ability damage. Save your engage for when his Q or Flash is down and punish him off the wave.
edits.after: Your leverage is any moment you actually reach him — but Blinding Dart (Q, 7s) blinds every basic attack for its duration, and The Darkin Glaive fires off an attack, so the blind cancels your Q outright. Wait the dart out, then use Aureate Rush (E, 10s) and the 850-range pull.

edits.before: Teemo's 6 floods the lane with Noxious Trap (R) shrooms, but the 1v1 still favours you — if you can pin him, your Q knock-up plus Final Retribution (R) kill him outright. The danger isn't the duel, it's stepping on shrooms mid-chase, so clear a path or all-in from a warded angle.
edits.after: Teemo's 6 floods the lane with Noxious Trap (R) — near-instant to place and held as charges, so the map, not the duel, is the problem. If you do pin him the Glaive recast knock-up plus Grim Deliverance kill him, but sweep a path first: a shroom mid-chase is how this lane ends.

edits.before: You stay ahead in a straight fight — your durability and Cultivation of War (P) sustain beat his poke once you close, and Blinding Dart (Q) can't stop your ability burst. The real threat is the shroom map, not him: respect the mushrooms and the lane is yours.
edits.after: Teemo pulls ahead: Toxic Shot (E) is on-hit magic poison scaling with his attack speed, so armour reads the trade wrong — buy Mercury's Treads and MR. Blinding Dart still shuts off your Q every 7s, so trade with Aureate Rush and the pull, not with attacks.

edits.before: You keep the 1v1 edge: Teemo is a squishy poke champ with no escape once you're on him, so isolate and burst him. His whole game is the shroom minefield slowing your map movement — sweep aggressively and kill him whenever you have vision to reach him.
edits.after: Teemo stays favoured: the shroom minefield decides where you can walk, and Guerrilla Warfare lets him hold invisibility in brush, so never facecheck. Sweep aggressively, take towers he cannot defend, and commit only while Blinding Dart is on its 7s.

edits.before: Level 2 favours you — squishy Teemo has no answer once you reach him, so gap-close with Darkin Glaive (Q) and Golden Onslaught (E) when his Blinding Dart (Q) is down; the blind only stops one auto, not your ability damage.
edits.after: Level 2 is Teemo's — Blinding Dart (Q, 7s) blinds every basic attack for its duration, and The Darkin Glaive is an attack, so the blind eats it whole. Farm through the poke and step up only once the dart is spent.

edits.before: Levels 3 through 6 stay yours in a straight duel: if you pin him your Q knock-up and Final Retribution (R) delete him, and his level 6 Noxious Trap (R) shrooms threaten your movement, not the fight itself — all-in from a warded angle and he dies.
edits.after: Levels 3 through 6 stay his: Toxic Shot (E) poison ticks for 4 seconds off every auto and Blinding Dart resets every 7s, so you rarely land a clean pattern. At 6 the shrooms take the map too — sweep, then all-in with Aureate Rush from a warded angle.

edits.before: With items you remain the better 1v1 — Teemo is a no-escape squishy, so isolate and burst him through his poke; his only real weapon is the shroom minefield that slows your map play, so sweep aggressively and kill him wherever you have vision to close.
edits.after: With items Teemo holds it — his on-hit poison is magic damage that armour ignores, so build MR, and the shroom minefield dictates where you can walk. Sweep aggressively, force towers, and kill him only when Blinding Dart is down and you have vision to close.

edits.before: Gap-closing with Q and Golden Onslaught (E) when his Blinding Dart (Q) is down
edits.after: Gap-closing with Aureate Rush (E) only once Blinding Dart's 7s is spent

edits.before: Blinding your auto with Blinding Dart (Q) mid-trade
edits.after: Blinding Dart (Q) shutting off your Q mid-attack

edits.before: Blinds your autos. Burst with spells. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is 7s flat — it blinds your Q attack too. Engage after it.

edits.before: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — Blinds your autos. Burst with spells. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — 7s flat, and it blinds The Darkin Glaive's attack, not just your autos. - Toxic Shot is on-hit magic: buy MR. - Move Quick 14s breaks when you hit him.
